cases.name: a drag is one gesture: the whole displacement against the layout he grabbed
a drag past collapse_below shuts the pane to a rail; between it and min it clamps at min
the last open pane never collapses
focusing a rail opens it (webchat activate)
add takes half the donor and focuses the new pane
a donor too narrow to halve above min gives an even split
removing the focused pane focuses its left neighbour; removing another keeps focus
shift and focus_neighbour resolve to absolute move and focus, skipping rails
